svg.text: A100 · MSAPairWeightedAveraging · training · d_msa 64, d_pair 128, 8 heads × 32, bf16, MSA residual, row dropout
forward (saves w, v, o, the LN statistics and the dropout keep-mask)
v = y @ W_v.T # head-major, ns chunks
F4 · gate + out projection + dropout + residual
backward (dres; the residual's gradient is dres itself)
g = sigmoid(y @ W_g_h.T); du = dr @ W_o_h
do = du * g; dgp = du * o * g (1 - g)
dW_o += dr^T (g o); dW_g += dgp^T y
dw = do @ v.T # fp32 [8 ns, L, L]
dW_v += dv^T y; dγ_m, dβ_m += sum(dy x̂), sum(dy)
db = w (dw - sum_j w dw) # softmax backward
dW_b, dγ_z, dβ_z from M = db^T x̂, sum db
